text: Salesforce, Inc. is listed on the NYSE (CRM); per its 2026 proxy statement, its largest disclosed 'Five Percent Stockholders' are The Vanguard Group (10.2%), BlackRock, Inc. (8.9%) and State Street Corporation (6.0%). No state or sovereign-fund holder is listed among them.

source.name: Salesforce, Inc., 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A)
source.quote: This table is based on information provided to us or filed with the SEC by our directors and director nominees, executive officers and principal stockholders.
